shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' lib/api.ts && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,180p' next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "test -d node_modules && echo installed || echo not-installed
rg -n \"declare function cacheLife|export.*cacheLife|cacheComponents\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts
rg -n \"cacheComponents\\??:\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20
rg -n \"use cache.*cacheComponents|cacheComponents.*use cache\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- tsconfig.json && test -f next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'find /workspace/.next -depth -delete
unlink /workspace/next-env.d.ts
unlink /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts'
